summary: KB time guard misses rtems-docs and Confluence documents: they carry no date
description:
Source: KB review 2026-11-04 (P7).

The time-based leak guard (ANVIL-43) hides documents created after a case's `as_of`. rtems-docs and Confluence documents have no date in their metadata, so the guard can't filter them. A doc page written after the fix could leak the answer.

**Want:**

* rtems-docs dated from the git log of each file (last commit date at the snapshot commit, or per-file history);
* Confluence pages dated from their created/updated times;
* undated documents are either excluded for a case with `as_of`, or the case's choice is recorded explicitly.

**Acceptance:** tests show a post-`as_of` docs page and Confluence page are hidden for a TC1 case.

comments.body:
[antigravity] PR #96 open: https://github.com/vishal7pandey/anvil/pull/96

Implementation details:

- rtems-docs: dated from git log history in a single fast pass using git log --name-only --format=COMMIT:%cI.

- Confluence / RTKB: dated from createdAt / versionCreatedAt in fetch_confluence_pages and confluence_get.

- Undated document policy recorded: in _SEARCH_SQL and store.py docstrings, when as_of is set, undated documents (created_at IS NULL) are excluded by default to ensure answer leaks cannot occur through undated pages.

- Snapshot backfill: _backfill_created_at in cli.py backfills created_at from doc_metadata across all sources.

Proven by: backend/tests/kb/test_time_guard.py (63/63 passed in KB test suite; verifies post-as_of docs and Confluence pages are hidden for TC1 case, and undated documents are excluded when as_of is active), backend/tests/kb/test_sources.py.

[antigravity] PR #96 updated in commit 4ff682d with full-history clone ingestion for rtems-docs (490/490 dated) and Confluence (12/12 dated). Total dated documents in re-exported snapshot: 7,573/7,576. Shallow-clone guard active to prevent tip-date pollution. Live proof of as_of hybrid search posted on PR.

[antigravity] PR #96 updated in commit 7824445: purged 3 dev test fixture pages (source=local) from DB, updated export_snapshot to exclude source=local by default (--include-local to opt in), re-exported clean snapshot manifest (7,573 docs, 14,654 chunks across confluence, gitlab-issue, gitlab-mr, and rtems-docs, all 100% dated), and updated sidecar vectors in private/handover/.

[claude] Done. Merged as 362ff01 (PR #96, antigravity; claude approved after the last commit, CI green; two review rounds).

Acceptance ("tests show a post-`as_of` docs page and Confluence page are hidden for a TC1 case"): `backend/tests/kb/test_time_guard.py::test_search_hides_post_as_of_docs_and_confluence_pages` runs against Postgres in CI: a docs page and a Confluence page created after 2026-09-20 are hidden, an undated Confluence page is excluded, older ones stay visible.

What shipped:

* rtems-docs dated from `git log` (latest commit per file, one pass; shallow clones are left undated with a warning, not stamped with the tip date); Confluence from created/version times.
* Policy recorded in `_SEARCH_SQL`: with `as_of` set, undated documents are excluded; with no `as_of`, everything is visible.
* The shipped snapshot is dated, which I counted myself: rtems-docs 490/490, confluence 12/12, gitlab issues 5519/5519, MRs 1552/1552. Under TC1's `as_of`, 483/490 docs, 5490/5519 issues and 1492/1552 MRs stay visible, so the KB is still useful to a TC1 run.
* `export-snapshot` skips `source = "local"` by default (a laptop's own run and ticket write-backs are not shipped); `--include-local` opts in. A first version of the snapshot had 3 test pages from another PR's tests; caught in review and removed.
* Snapshot and handover vectors sidecar hashes match their manifests.

Not covered: pages in other sources get no date (only these two were undated); the dating of docs is "last changed", which errs toward hiding.
